title: Gapped graphene model: Berry phase and Berry flux at K
summary: The honeycomb model with a sublattice gap (t = -1, delta = -0.2 eV): bands, the Berry phase of each band and of both on a circle around K, and the Berry flux on a square patch around K, with a map of the Berry curvature. No DFT run; seconds.

steps.label: Bands, Berry phase and Berry flux around K
steps.note: writes output/ and the Berry-curvature map output/berry_phase_k.pdf
